segments.text: A stranger offers you one million dollars.
You can never use a phone again. Any phone. For the rest of your life.
No maps. No group chats. No two-factor codes for your bank.
Your friends would have to write to you. Or knock.
But you'd watch every concert with your own eyes. And nobody could reach you at 2 a.m.
Here's the twist. The money is in a bank you can only log into with a phone.
So, take the million, or keep your phone?
